steps.text: Hello, I'm [Your name] from Ajant Bureau{{nameClause}}. How can I help you today?
steps.tips: Speak clearly and with a smile.

steps.text: I'm listening carefully. Could you give me more details about your request?
steps.tips: Take notes. Rephrase to confirm understanding.

steps.text: Perfect, here is what I can offer you: [your solution]. Does that match your needs?
steps.tips: Be concise and direct.

steps.text: To summarize, we agreed on [summary]. I'll send you a confirmation by email. Do you have any other questions?
steps.tips: Recap the actions taken.

steps.text: Thank you for your call. Feel free to contact us again. Have a great day!
steps.tips: Leave a positive impression.

steps.text: I fully understand your dissatisfaction and I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
steps.tips: Don't defend yourself immediately. Validate the feeling first.

steps.text: In order to handle your request as best I can, could you specify the date and the exact nature of the problem encountered?
steps.tips: Listen without interrupting. Ask open questions.

steps.text: I'm personally taking charge of your complaint. Here are the actions I will take immediately: [concrete actions].
steps.tips: Give a precise timeframe. Commit only to what you can keep.

steps.text: To make up for this harm, I propose [solution/compensation]. Does this solution suit you?
steps.tips: Offer a solution before they ask for it.

steps.text: I'll confirm by email within the hour. I'll personally contact you again within [timeframe] to make sure you're satisfied.
steps.tips: Keep your commitments absolutely.

steps.text: To offer you the most suitable solution, I have a few questions. What is your main challenge right now?
steps.tips: Listen more than you speak. 70/30.

steps.text: What is your timeline for this project? Have you already evaluated other solutions?
steps.tips: Identify the budget, the decision-making authority and the urgency.

steps.text: Based on your needs, our [product/service] solution would let you [benefit 1], [benefit 2] and [benefit 3].
steps.tips: Talk benefits, not features.

steps.text: I understand this concern. Many of our clients shared it at first. Here's how we resolve it: [answer].
steps.tips: Rephrase the objection positively before answering.

steps.text: To go further, I'll prepare a personalized proposal for you. What's the best time this week to present it to you?
steps.tips: Always propose a concrete next step.

steps.text: Hello{{nameClause}}, I'm following up on our exchange of [date]. Have you had the chance to review my proposal?
steps.tips: Be natural, not pushy.

steps.text: Which points still seem unclear to you or require clarification from me?
steps.tips: Question rather than force.

steps.text: That's completely normal. Here's how we can address this point precisely: [tailored answer].
steps.tips: Every blocker is an opportunity to adapt the offer.

steps.text: I must inform you that this offer is valid until [date]. After that, the pricing terms could change.
steps.tips: Urgency must be real to stay credible.

steps.text: How about a 30-minute meeting to finalize the details? I'm available [propose 2 time slots].
steps.tips: Always offer two options, never an open question.

steps.text: Hello, Ajant Bureau support service. Can you describe precisely the problem you're experiencing?
steps.tips: Ask closed questions to diagnose quickly.

steps.text: How long have you been experiencing this problem? On what device or browser? Did you notice any particular error message?
steps.tips: Collect as much information as possible before acting.

steps.text: Here is the procedure to follow step by step: [steps]. Are you ready to try? I'll stay with you.
steps.tips: Guide step by step. Wait for confirmation at each step.

steps.text: Were you able to resolve the problem? Is the application working correctly now?
steps.tips: Never close without confirmation.

steps.text: To prevent this from happening again, here is what I recommend: [advice]. I'll send you a summary by email.
steps.tips: Turn the incident into a learning opportunity.

steps.text: Hello and welcome to Ajant Bureau! I'm [name], your account manager. I'm delighted to have you with us.
steps.tips: The first impression lasts. Be enthusiastic and sincere.

steps.text: In a few words, I'll present how we'll work together and the next steps.
steps.tips: Reassure immediately about what's going to happen.

steps.text: To best personalize our support, what made you decide to join us? What are your main objectives?
steps.tips: Note the expressed expectations word for word.

steps.text: Here is what I propose to get started: [onboarding plan]. The next step will be [action] that I commit to doing before [date].
steps.tips: Commit to concrete and dated actions.

steps.text: I'll be your dedicated point of contact. Feel free to reach out to me directly. My goal is your success.
steps.tips: Position yourself as a partner, not a vendor.
